answer.summary: ArchRuleRegistrationTest fails deterministically: TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest#scenario_revisions_repository_access_is_reviewed is neither annotated @ArchTest nor listed in HELPERS, so the arch-rule registration check rejects it. This is a static check and will fail again on retry. The NoHttpResponseException and Jackson parse errors in the log are unrelated noise. The touched-files list has no openaev-api file, so confirm where this new rule came from before fixing.
